text: My daughter is 11 and has had a temperature of 38 since this afternoon, plus a sore throat. She's still drinking fine, just says it scratches a bit when she swallows. I checked her all over and there's no rash anywhere. Mostly I want to check doses. How much paracetamol can she have at her age, and can I give ibuprofen as well or should it be one or the other? She's tall for 11 if that makes a difference. Thanks.
